custom_field: প্রতি প্রশ্নের মান ১ ও ভুল উত্তরের জন্য ০.৫০ কাটা যাবে।

Daily-Quiz.question: ১) No other language in the world is as widely spoken as English. (Make it comparative)
Daily-Quiz.option1: English is more widely spoken than more other languages in the world.
Daily-Quiz.option2: English is widely spoken than all other languages in the world.
Daily-Quiz.option3: English is more widely spoken than any other language in the world.
Daily-Quiz.option4: English is more widely spoken than many other language in the world.
Daily-Quiz.exp:
• No other যুক্ত positive sentence কে comparative হলে - 
- শেষের subject প্রথমে বসে এবং এরপর verb আসে। 
- adjective এর comparative form বসাতে হয়।
- than any other 
- no other এর পরের অংশ।
- সুতরাং, নিয়মানুযায়ী সঠিক উত্তর - English is more widely spoken than any other language in the world. 

More Examples: 
Positive: No other river in Bangladesh is as long as the Padma.
Comparative: The Padma is longer than any other river in Bangladesh.

Positive: No other mountain in the world is as high as Mount Everest.
Comparative: Mount Everest is higher than any other mountain in the world.

Daily-Quiz.question: ২) China is the most populated country in the world. (Make it positive)
Daily-Quiz.option1: No other countries in the world are as populated as China.
Daily-Quiz.option2: No other country in the world is as populated as China.
Daily-Quiz.option3: Very few country in the world is as populated as China.
Daily-Quiz.option4: Very few countries in the world are as populated as China.
Daily-Quiz.exp:
Superlative: China is the most populated country in the world.
Positive: No other country in the world is as populated as China.

• Superlative কে positive করতে হলে চারটি কাজ করতে হয়:
1. Subject- Object হয়, Object - Subject হয়।
2. Affirmative -Negative হয়, Negative Affirmative হয়।
3. Degree change হয়।
4. Indicator Change হয় (as... as/ so....as --> than)।

• The + superlative যুক্ত বাক্যকে positive করার নিয়ম-
- No other +singular Noun + singular Verb+ as/so + Positive Degree+ as +Subject of Positive Degree.

• Example:
• Superlative: Rafee is the smallest player on the team.
• Positive: No other player in the team is as small as Rafee.

• Superlative: Pride is the greatest vice.
• Positive: No other vice is as great as pride.

• অন্যদিকে, 
• Superlative বাক্যে One of the থাকলে সেটিকে Positive করার নিয়ম হচ্ছে:
- Very few + positive degree এর পরের Plural Noun + Plural Verb + as/so + Positive Degree + as + Subject of Positive Degree.

• Superlative: Pride is one of the greatest vices.
• Positive:  Very few vices are as great as pride.

Daily-Quiz.question: ৩) This city is cleaner than all other cities in the country. (Make it superlative)
Daily-Quiz.option1: This is the cleanest city in the country.
Daily-Quiz.option2: This is the cleanest cities in the country.
Daily-Quiz.option3: This is one of the cleanest cities in the country.
Daily-Quiz.option4: This is one of the cleanest city in the country.
Daily-Quiz.exp:
• Comparative Degree + than all other/ than any other থাকলে (the + superlative degree) হয়।
- the + superlative degree এর পর Singular Noun বসে।

• Structure:
- প্রথম Subject প্রথমেই বসে
- এরপর Verb +  the + Comparative Degree-এর Superlative form +  Singular Noun বসে
- সব শেষে  than all other/ than any other এর পরের অংশ।

• নিয়মানুযায়ী সঠিক উত্তর -
Comparative: This city is cleaner than all other cities in the country.
Superlative: This is the cleanest city in the country.

• অন্যদিকে,
• Than most other/ than few other যুক্ত Comparative Degree কে Superlative Degree তে রূপান্তরের নিয়ম:
• Structure:
- প্রথম Subject প্রথমেই বসে
- এরপর Verb + one of the + Comparative Degree-এর Superlative form + Plural noun বসে
- সব শেষে  most other/ few other এর পরের অংশ।
- যেমন:
Comparative: This city is cleaner than most other cities in the country.
Superlative: This is one of the cleanest cities in the country.

Daily-Quiz.question: ৪) She is as intelligent as her brother. (Make it comparative)
Daily-Quiz.option1: Her brother is not more intelligent than her.
Daily-Quiz.option2: Her brother is no less intelligent than her.
Daily-Quiz.option3: She is not intelligent than her brother.
Daily-Quiz.option4: Both ক + খ
Daily-Quiz.exp:
• Structure: as + adjective/as যুক্ত positive sentence কে দুইভাবে comparative করা যায়: 
- Subject ঠিক থাকে এবং not less+ positive degree বসে।
- যেমন: 
Positive: She is as intelligent as her brother.
Comparative: She is not less intelligent than her brother.

• অথবা, 
• Object- Subject হয়ে বসে  + not + comparative degree বসে।
- যেমন: 
Positive: She is as intelligent as her brother.
Comparative: Her brother is not more intelligent than her.

• অপশনে - Her brother is not more intelligent than her. - আছে তাই এটিই সঠিক উত্তর।
• খ) অপশনে not less এর পরিবর্তে no less দেওয়া আছে। তাই এটি সঠিক নয়।

Daily-Quiz.question: ৫) Shakespeare is greater than most other poets in English literature. (Make it positive)
Daily-Quiz.option1: Very few poets in English literature are as great as Shakespeare.
Daily-Quiz.option2: Very few poet in English literature is as great as Shakespeare.
Daily-Quiz.option3: No other poets in English literature are as great as Shakespeare.
Daily-Quiz.option4: No other poet in English literature is as great as Shakespeare.
Daily-Quiz.exp:
• Comparative: Shakespeare is greater than most other poets in English literature.
• Positive: Very few poets in English literature are as great as Shakespeare.

• Than most other/than few other যুক্ত Comparative Degree কে Positive Degree তে রূপান্তর করার নিয়ম:
(i) প্রথমে Very few বসে + (ii) few other/most other এর পরের অংশ বসে + (iii) verb এর Plural বসে+ (iv) so বসে + (v) Comparative degree এর Positive form বসে + (vi) as বসে (vii) প্রদত্ত sentence এর subject বসে।

যেমন -
Comparative: The cow is more useful than most other animals.
Positive: Very few animals are as useful as the cow.

Daily-Quiz.question: ৬) This road is wider than most other roads in the city. (Make it superlative)
Daily-Quiz.option1: This is one of the widest road in the city.
Daily-Quiz.option2: This is one of the widest roads in the city.
Daily-Quiz.option3: This is the widest roads in the city.
Daily-Quiz.option4: This is the widest road in the city.
Daily-Quiz.exp:
Comparative: This road is wider than most other roads in the city.
Superlative: This is one of the widest roads in the city.

• Than most other/ than few other যুক্ত Comparative Degree কে Superlative Degree তে রূপান্তরের নিয়ম:
• Structure:
- প্রথম Subject প্রথমেই বসে
- এরপর Verb + one of the + Comparative Degree-এর Superlative form + Plural noun বসে
- সব শেষে  most other/ few other এর পরের অংশ বসে। 

- যেমন:
Comparative: This book is more interesting than few other books/ most other books I have read.
Superlative: This is one of the most interesting books I have read.

Daily-Quiz.question: ৭) No sooner had I finished my work than I went out for a walk. (Make it positive)
Daily-Quiz.option1: Hardly as I finished my work, I went out for a walk.
Daily-Quiz.option2: As soon I had finished my work, I went out for a walk.
Daily-Quiz.option3: Hardly soon as I finished my work, I went out for a walk.
Daily-Quiz.option4: As soon as I finished my work, I went out for a walk.
Daily-Quiz.exp:
Comparative: No sooner had I finished my work than I went out for a walk.
Positive: As soon as I finished my work, I went out for a walk.

• Comparative এ No sooner had …… than থাকলে As soon as বসিয়ে positive করা হয়।
- Sooner comparative form এর positive form soon বসে এবং than উঠিয়ে দেয়া হয় এবং as .... as যোগ হয়।
- As soon as যুক্ত sentence টি এরপর শুধু comma বসে।
- দুইটি clause ই past indefinite এ হয়।

• Example: 
Comparative: No sooner had he graduated than he got a job.
Positive: As soon as he graduated, he got a job.

Daily-Quiz.question: ৮) It is certain that she will succeed. (Make it simple)
Daily-Quiz.option1: Her being successful is certain.
Daily-Quiz.option2: She would succeed, certainly.
Daily-Quiz.option3: Certainly, she will succeed.
Daily-Quiz.option4: She will be successful is certain.
Daily-Quiz.exp:
Complex: It is certain that she will succeed.
Simple: Certainly she will succeed.

• Complex sentence এ it is certain, it is surely, it is sudden থাকলে Simple sentence এ -
- It is certain এর পরিবর্তে certainly হবে + এর পরের relative pronoun টি বাদ যাবে + বাকি sentence টি বসবে।
• সুতরাং, নিয়মানুযায়ী, সঠিক উত্তর - Certainly, she will succeed.

• অন্য দিকে, 
- it is sure এর পরিবর্তে surely হবে
- it is sudden এর পরিবর্তে suddenly হবে.

যেমন:
Complex: It is certain that he will come here.
Simple: Certainly, he will come here.

Complex: It was sudden that he lost his mobile.
Simple: Suddenly, he lost his mobile.

Complex: It is sure that he has done it.
Simple: Surely, he has done it.

Source: Advance Learner's English Grammar and Composition by Chowdhury & Hossain.

Daily-Quiz.question: ৯) When he was ten, he won his first competition. (Make it simple)
Daily-Quiz.option1: It was at the age of ten, he won his first competition.
Daily-Quiz.option2: At the age of ten, he won his first competition.
Daily-Quiz.option3: He was at the age of ten, he won his first competition.
Daily-Quiz.option4: At his age of ten, he won his first competition.
Daily-Quiz.exp:
Complex: When he was ten, he won his first competition.
Simple: At the age of ten, he won his first competition.

• When যুক্ত সময় নির্দেশক Complex Sentence কে Simple Sentence এ রূপান্তর করার নিয়ম: 
- When clause এ ছোট সময়/ বয়স/ ঋতুর উল্লেখ থাকলে, 
- When উঠে যায় + When এর পরে যে Subject ও Verb থাকে তা উঠে যায় + ছোট সময় বুঝালে at/in বসে, ঋতু থাকলে তার পূর্বে in বসে, বয়সের উল্লেখ থাকলে তার পূর্বে at the age of বসে + পরবর্তী clause অপরিবর্তিত থাকে। 

Examples: 
Complex Sentence: When it is spring, the cuckoo sings. 
Simple Sentence: In spring the cuckoo sings. 

Complex Sentence: When he was four, he left his village.
Simple Sentence: At the age of four, he left his village.

Daily-Quiz.question: ১০) As I had forgotten him I went out. (Make it simple)
Daily-Quiz.option1: Forgetting him, I went out.
Daily-Quiz.option2: Having forgotten him, I went out.
Daily-Quiz.option3: Being forgetting him, I went out.
Daily-Quiz.option4: Both ক + খ
Daily-Quiz.exp:
• Complex: As I had forgotten him I went out. 
• Simple: Forgetting him, I went out or Having forgotten him, I went out.
- সুতরাং, সঠিক উত্তর হবে - Both ক + খ। 

• যখন As বা Since যুক্ত complex sentence-এর দুটি clause এর subject একই হয়, তখন present participle (V-ing) বা perfect participle (Having + past participle) ব্যবহার করে simple sentence তৈরি করা যায়। 
- সেক্ষেত্রে, First clause-এর verb-এর present participle (V-ing) বা perfect participle (Having + past participle) ব্যবহার করতে হবে।
- Second clause-এর subject বাদ দিয়ে verb ব্যবহার করতে হবে, কারণ দুটি clause-এর subject একই।
- As বা Since-এর মানে "যেহেতু" বা "কারণ", সুতরাং, প্রথম clause-এ বলা action বা condition reason হিসেবে ব্যবহৃত হয়।

• Example: As he had finished his homework, he played outside.
Simple Sentence:
Having finished his homework, he played outside.
Finishing his homework, he played outside.

Daily-Quiz.question: ১১) Unless you finish the task, you cannot leave. (Make it compound)
Daily-Quiz.option1: You cannot leave unless you finish the task.
Daily-Quiz.option2: Finish the task unless you cannot leave.
Daily-Quiz.option3: Finish the task either you cannot leave.
Daily-Quiz.option4: Finish the task or you cannot leave.
Daily-Quiz.exp:
Complex: Unless you finish the task, you cannot leave.
Compound: Finish the task or you cannot leave.

• Complex sentence এর শুরুতে  “Unless” ও এর পরে second person (you) থাকলে, Compound sentence- এ রূপান্তর করার নিয়ম: 
- Unless ও you উঠে যাবে।
- দুই clause এর মাঝে ”or” বসে। 
- অন্য কোনো পরিবর্তন হবে না।

Example:
Complex: Unless you watch closely, you will miss the scenario.
Compound: Watch closely or you will miss the scenario.

Daily-Quiz.question: ১২) Since they arrived late, they missed the presentation. (Make it compound)
Daily-Quiz.option1: They arrived late, so therefore they missed the presentation.
Daily-Quiz.option2: They arrived late, and they missed the presentation.
Daily-Quiz.option3: They arrived late, and so that they missed the presentation.
Daily-Quiz.option4: They arrived late, therefore so they missed the presentation.
Daily-Quiz.exp:
Complex: Since they arrived late, they missed the presentation.
Compound: They arrived late, and so they missed the presentation.

• Compound Sentence এ কাজের ধারাবাহিকতা অনুযায়ী Clause গুলো বসে।
- সর্বদা প্রথমে কারন এবং পরে ফলাফল আসে।
- Complex sentence এ as/ since/ because ইত্যাদি থাকলে
- প্রথমে as/ since/ because উঠে যায় এবং subject বসে,
- দুই clause এর মাঝখানে and/ and so বসে।
- Comma (,) বসে

• Compound sentence-এ একের অধিক principal clause থাকে যাদেরকে co-ordinate clause বলা হয়।
- অর্থাৎ Compound sentence এ দুই বা ততোধিক principal clause বা co-ordinate clause থাকে।
- এছাড়া Compound sentence এ সাধারণত and, or, but, yet, so, therefore, otherwise, else, both --- and , either --- or , neither — nor, not only --- but also ইত্যাদি coordinating conjunction দ্বারা দুইটি principal clause যুক্ত থাকে

Daily-Quiz.question: ১৩) He is too young to understand the problem. (Make it compound)
Daily-Quiz.option1: He is young and so he cannot understand the problem.
Daily-Quiz.option2: He is young and he cannot understand the problem.
Daily-Quiz.option3: He is very young and cannot understand the problem.
Daily-Quiz.option4: He is so young and that he cannot understand the problem.
Daily-Quiz.exp:
Complex: He is too young to understand the problem.
Compound: He is very young and cannot understand the problem.

• প্রদত্ত sentence টি simple sentence এ আছে।
- Too + to যুক্ত Simple sentence কে Compound sentence এ পরিণত করার নিয়ম:
-Too এর পরিবর্তে very বসবে এবং to এর পরিবর্তে and বসবে,
- tense অনুযায়ী cannot/could not বসে,
- to এর পরের অংশ।

Simple: Runa is too weak to move.
Compound: Runa is very weak and cannot move.

Daily-Quiz.question: ১৪) After the lecture ended, everyone left the auditorium. (Make it complex)
Daily-Quiz.option1: After the lecture had ended, everyone left the auditorium.
Daily-Quiz.option2: Since the lecture had ended, everyone left the auditorium.
Daily-Quiz.option3: When the lecture had ended, everyone left the auditorium.
Daily-Quiz.option4: As the lecture ended, everyone left the auditorium.
Daily-Quiz.exp:
• Before/after/ ইত্যাদি যুক্ত simple sentence কে complex এ পরিণত করতে দুইটি নিয়ম অনুসরণ করা যায়।

• Complex sentence এ -
- After যুক্ত clause টি past perfect tense এ হয়, তবে পরের clause টি past indefinite এ হবে। অর্থাৎ, 
- প্রথমে After বসবে + এরপর subject + verb এর past perfect form বসে,
- তারপর দ্বিতীয় subject + verb এর past form বসে।
- নিয়মানুযায়ী সঠিক complex sentence টি হচ্ছে - After the lecture had ended, everyone left the auditorium.

• আবার, 
- After এর পরিবর্তে when বসে, 
- verb এর past indefinite form বসে
- দ্বিতীয় subject + বাকি অংশ।
- নিয়মানুযায়ী  - When the lecture ended, everyone left the auditorium.

Daily-Quiz.question: ১৫) Having attended the meeting, they returned to their desks. (Make it Complex)
Daily-Quiz.option1: When they have attended the meeting, they returned to their desks.
Daily-Quiz.option2: After attending the meeting, they returned to their desks.
Daily-Quiz.option3: When they had attended the meeting, they returned to their desks.
Daily-Quiz.option4: After they attend the meeting, they returned to their desks.
Daily-Quiz.exp:
Simple: Having attended the meeting, they returned to their desks.
Complex: When they had attended the meeting, they returned to their desks.

• Structure:
• Simple Sentence to Complex Sentence: (Having + Verb এর past participle form যুক্ত)
• Structure: Having এর পরিবর্তে When বসে + Subject + had + Verb এর past participle form + বাকী অংশ।

• এ বাক্যে প্রথমেই Having এর পরিবর্তে When বসেছে।
- তারপর Subject - they বসেছে।
- এরপর had + Verb এর past participle form - attended বসেছে।
- বাকী অংশ অপরিবর্তিত রয়েছে।

• এ জাতীয় আরোও একটি উদাহরণ - 
- Simple: Having told this, he went away.
- Complex: When he had told he went away.

- Simple: Having done this, he went away.
- Complex: When he had done this he went away.

Source: Advanced Learners Communicative English Grammar & Composition By Chowdhury & Hossain.

Daily-Quiz.question: ১৬) I wanted to join the party, but I had an urgent task. (Complex)
Daily-Quiz.option1: Even though I wanted to join the party, but yet I had an urgent task.
Daily-Quiz.option2: Although I wanted to join the party, but I had an urgent task.
Daily-Quiz.option3: Although I wanted to join the party, I had an urgent task.
Daily-Quiz.option4: Even though I wanted to join the party, but I had an urgent task.
Daily-Quiz.exp:
Compound: I wanted to join the party, but I had an urgent task.
Complex: Although I wanted to join the party, I had an urgent task.

• Compound Sentence এ but থাকলে Complex Sentence এর ক্ষেত্রে Though/Although ব্যবহৃত হয়।

• Complex Sentence: 
- যে sentence- এ একটি Principal Clause এবং এক বা একাধিক Subordinate Clause থাকে, তাকে Complex sentence বলে। 
- Complex Sentence এর Subordinate Clause এর শুরুতে সাধারণত if, though, although, as, because, since, so that, that, until, till, unless, when, why, who, which, where, how, before, after, whether, while বসে।

More Examples:
Compound sentence: He is poor but he is honest.
Complex Sentence: Though he is poor, he is honest.

Compound Sentence: The weather was gloomy, but the atmosphere was cheerful. 
Complex Sentence: Though the weather was gloomy, the atmosphere was cheerful.

Daily-Quiz.question: ১৭) Will she complete the project? (Make it passive)
Daily-Quiz.option1: Will the project completed by her?
Daily-Quiz.option2: Will be the project completed by her?
Daily-Quiz.option3: Will the project be completed by her?
Daily-Quiz.option4: Will be the project complet by her?
Daily-Quiz.exp:
Active: Will she complete the project?
Passive: Will the project be completed by her?

• Active voice থেকে passive voice করার নিয়ম:
- Active voice এর object টি passive voice এর subject হয়।
- Tense অনুযায়ী auxiliary verb বসে।
- তারপর মূল verb এর past participle হয়।
- Active voice এর subject টি passive voice এর object হয়।
- তার পূর্বে preposition (by, with, at, to, in) বসে।

• প্রশ্নে Will they do it? একটি interrogative sentence.
• Active থেকে Passive করার নিয়ম:
Active: Shall/will + subject + verb + object?
Passive: Shall/will + subject + be + Vpp + by + object?

Source: A Passage to the English Language, S.M. Zakir Hussain.

Daily-Quiz.question: ১৮) I was helped to finish the document by Raha. (Make it active)
Daily-Quiz.option1: Raha helped me finish the document.
Daily-Quiz.option2: Raha helps me finish the document.
Daily-Quiz.option3: Raha helps me to finish the document.
Daily-Quiz.option4: Raha helped me to finish the document.
Daily-Quiz.exp:
• Make, need, dare, bare, hear, feel, know, ইত্যাদি causative verb গুলোর পর active voice এ bare infinitive অর্থাৎ to উহ্য থাকে। 
- কিন্তু passive এ পরিবর্তন করবার সময় তাদের পর to বসাতে হয়। 

- তাই প্রশ্নে উল্লেখিতI  was helped to finish the document by Raha.  - বাক্যটিকে active করার সময় - 
- প্রথমে  object টি subject রূপে বসবে + causative verb + subject টি object রূপে বসবে + main verb বসবে।
- to উঠে যাবে।

• এই নিয়মানুযায়ী সঠিক উত্তর হবে -
Passive: I was helped to finish the document by Raha.
Active: Raha helped me finish the document.

Daily-Quiz.question: ১৯) The company was reviewing the policy. (Make it passive)
Daily-Quiz.option1: The policy was reviewed by the company.
Daily-Quiz.option2: The policy were being reviewed by the company.
Daily-Quiz.option3: The policy was been reviewed by the company.
Daily-Quiz.option4: The policy was being reviewed by the company.
Daily-Quiz.exp:
Active: The company was reviewing the policy.
Passive: The policy was being reviewed by the company.

• Active voice থেকে passive voice করার নিয়ম:
- Active voice এর object টি passive voice এর subject হয়।
- Tense অনুযায়ী auxiliary verb বসে।
- তারপর মূল verb এর past participle হয়।
- Active voice এর subject টি passive voice এর object হয়।
- তার পূর্বে preposition (by, with, at, to, in) বসে।

• The company was reviewing the policy - বাক্যটি Past Continuous tense এ আছে।
- এই sentence টির passive voice এর structure হবে: Sub + am/is/are/was/were + being + verb in past participle. 
- তাই এর সঠিক passive form হবে: The policy was being reviewed by the company.

Daily-Quiz.question: ২০) Shut the box carefully. (Make it passive)
Daily-Quiz.option1: Let the box be shutted carefully.
Daily-Quiz.option2: Let the box be shuted carefully.
Daily-Quiz.option3: Let the box shut carefully.
Daily-Quiz.option4: Let the box be shut carefully.
Daily-Quiz.exp:
Active: Shut the box carefully.
Passive: Let the box be shut carefully.

• মূল Verb দ্বারা আরম্ভ হওয়া imperative sentence কে passive voice করার নিয়ম:
- প্রথমে Let বসে।
- object  +  be বসে।
- verb এর past participle বসে।

• Example:
Active voice: Tell him to do it.
Passive Voice: Let him be told to do it.

Daily-Quiz.question: ২১) Why was a plan proposed? (Make it active)
Daily-Quiz.option1: Why plan was proposed?
Daily-Quiz.option2: Why did somebody proposed a plan?
Daily-Quiz.option3: Why did they propose a plan?
Daily-Quiz.option4: Why somebody proposed a plan?
Daily-Quiz.exp:
Passive: Why was a plan proposed?
Active: Why did they propose a plan?

• Passive voice কে Active voice এ রূপান্তরিত করার নিয়ম:
- Passive voice এর object‌ টি Active Voice এর subject হয়,
- Tense অনুযায়ী Auxiliary verb বসে,
- মূল verb এর base form হয়,
- Passive voice এর subject টি Active voice এর object হয়,
- তার পূর্বে Preposition (By, with, at, to, in) উঠে যায়।

• Passive Voice এ যদি by + Object না থাকে এবং verb টি যদি পেশা বা নির্দিষ্ট ব্যক্তি বা বস্তুর সাথে Related কাজ হয় তাহলে ঐ পেশা জীবী বা ঐ নির্দিষ্ট ব্যক্তি বা বস্তুর নাম Subject হিসেবে বসাতে হবে অথবা একটি সুবিধাজনক subject ধরে নিয়ে active করতে হবে।
- সে অনুযায়ী সঠিক উত্তর হবে - Why do they propose a plan?

Daily-Quiz.question: ২২) The student's performance pleased the teacher. (Make it passive)
Daily-Quiz.option1: The teacher was pleased by the student's performance.
Daily-Quiz.option2: The teacher was pleased at the student's performance.
Daily-Quiz.option3: The teacher was pleased with the student's performance.
Daily-Quiz.option4: The teacher was pleased from the student's performance.
Daily-Quiz.exp:
Active Voice: The student's performance pleased the teacher.
Passive Voice: The teacher was pleased at the student's performance.

• Active voice কে Passive voice এ রূপান্তরের নিয়ম:
- Active Voice এর object‌ টি Passive voice এর subject হয় + Tense অনুযায়ী Auxiliary verb + মূল verb এর past participle + Active voice এর subject টি Passive voice এর object হয় এবং তার পূর্বে Preposition (By, with, at, to,in) বসে।

• ব্যক্তির ক্ষেত্রে with বসে আর ব্যক্তির কাজ বা বস্তুর উপরে সন্তুষ্টি বোঝাতে at বসে।
- যেহেতু প্রশ্নে ব্যক্তির কাজের উপর সন্তুষ্টি বোঝানো হয়েছে তাই pleased at বসবে।

Daily-Quiz.question: ২৩) The children laughed at the clown. (Make it passive)
Daily-Quiz.option1: The clown was laughed at with the children.
Daily-Quiz.option2: The clown was laughed at by the children.
Daily-Quiz.option3: The clown was laughed by the children.
Daily-Quiz.option4: The clown was laughed by at the children.
Daily-Quiz.exp:
Active: The children laughed at the clown.
Passive: The clown was laughed at by the children

• Past Indefinite Tense যুক্ত Active Voice কে Passive Voice এ রূপান্তর করার নিয়ম হলো -
- Object এর Subject form হবে + was/were + verb এর past participle form + by + subject এর object.
- Active Voice এর sentence এ কোনো Group verb থাকলে Voice change করার সময় Group verb এর Preposition টি verb এর সাথেই থাকে; এর পরে by বসাতে হয়।

Daily-Quiz.question: ২৪) We are going to start a new project. (Make it passive)
Daily-Quiz.option1: A new project is going to started by us.
Daily-Quiz.option2: A new project is going to be start by us.
Daily-Quiz.option3: A new project is going to being started by us.
Daily-Quiz.option4: A new project is going to be started by us.
Daily-Quiz.exp:
Active: We are going to start a new project.
Passive: A new project is going to be started by us.

• Active voice থেকে passive voice করার নিয়ম:

- Active voice এর object টি passive voice এর subject হয়।
- Tense অনুযায়ী auxiliary verb বসে।
- তারপর মূল verb এর past participle হয়।
- Active voice এর subject টি passive voice এর object হয়।
- তার পূর্বে preposition (by, with, at, to, in) বসে।

• Going to যুক্ত বাক্যের passive করার সময় Going to + be + verb এর past participle হয়।

• Example: 
- Active: He is going to open a shop.
- Passive: A shop is going to be opened by him.

Daily-Quiz.question: ২৫) People always admire great leaders. (Make it passive)
Daily-Quiz.option1: Great leaders are always being admired.
Daily-Quiz.option2: Great leaders are always admired by the people.
Daily-Quiz.option3: Great leaders are always admired.
Daily-Quiz.option4: Great leaders will always be admired by people.
Daily-Quiz.exp:
Active: People always admire great leaders.
Passive: Great leaders are always admired.

• Active voice কে Passive Voice- এ রূপান্তরের নিয়ম:
- Active Voice এর object টি Passive Voice এর Subject হয়।
- Active Voice এর মূল Verb এর form অনুযায়ী অতিরিক্ত ‘be’ Verb বসে।
- মূল verb এর Past Participle form বসে।
- Active Voice এর subject টি Passive Voice এর Object হয় এবং তার পূর্বে Preposition (By, with, at, to, in) বসে।

• তবে,  Active Voice এর Subject People হলে, তা Passive Voice এর Object হিসেবে না লিখলেও চলে।
